caption: The Paired button lists the notes that link to Recipes, and that Recipes links to.
eval: (async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); await app.commands.executeCommandById('one-way-backlinks:open'); const v=app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('one-way-backlinks')[0].view; v.setMode('paired'); for (let i=0;i<60 && document.querySelectorAll('.owb-view .owb-row').length!==2;i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('.owb-view .owb-row').length; if (n!==2) throw new Error('rows '+n+' want 2'); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro: Link back adds a link to Banana bread at the end of Recipes, and the row moves to Paired.
eval: (async () => { const p=app.plugins.plugins['one-way-backlinks']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('one-way-backlinks-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); if (!p.pro.isPro()) throw new Error('pro off'); document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); await app.commands.executeCommandById('one-way-backlinks:open'); const v=app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('one-way-backlinks')[0].view; v.setMode('one-way'); for (let i=0;i<60 && document.querySelectorAll('.owb-view .owb-row').length!==4;i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('.owb-view .owb-row').length; if (n!==4) throw new Error('rows '+n+' want 4'); const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('.owb-view .owb-row')].find(r=>r.querySelector('.owb-name').textContent==='Banana bread'); row.querySelector('.owb-link-back').click(); for (let i=0;i<150 && document.querySelectorAll('.owb-view .owb-row').length!==3;i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const n=document.querySelectorAll('.owb-view .owb-row').length; if (n!==3) throw new Error('rows '+n+' want 3'); return 'ok'; })()
